en: Black‑and‑white image of a high‑altitude landscape with snow‑covered volcanic peaks in the background and grassy alpine terrain with scattered trees in the foreground. Several figures in wide‑brimmed hats and traditional-looking clothing travel on foot and on horseback along a path through the grass, moving toward the mountains. The style resembles an early to mid‑20th‑century travel postcard. No printed caption or writing is visible on the front.
